output.brief:
The buffering in Kestria comes from the smart-TV app 5.2 release, not the new CDN. Kestria was the test market for 5.2, which went live on 9 Oct, the same day as the CDN cutover. The release lowered the startup buffer from 10 s to 4 s. Smart-TV 5.2 sessions stall 5.9% of the time. Every other client on the same CDN and the same ISPs stalls about 0.6%. Smart-TV 5.1 devices on Tessaline are also fine. Employee test TVs on the old CDN showed the same problem before launch (5.7% against 0.6%), and the issue was deferred. Handball launched two days after the rise began, and stalls didn't change on match nights. ISP congestion doesn't fit either, since the other clients on those ISPs are fine. I'm about 90% sure.

Next steps:
1. Do not send the SLA notice, withhold fees or move traffic back. That would punish the wrong party and wouldn't fix the problem.
2. Do not mute the alert.
3. Revert the abr_v2 remote-config settings for Kestria. This takes about an hour and needs no new build. Hold the 20 Nov wider rollout until it is fixed.
4. Later, add app version and device breakdowns to the dashboard.
5. Don't offer the win-back free month yet. The October cancellations also coincide with the 1 Oct price rise, so buffering isn't established as the cause.
